title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion, UCLA on 1982-02-21
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Apogee aes/ebu cable > Sound Devices 744T (wav 16/44.1)> Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1982 show featuring a standout Shakedown Street jam, soaring Stella Blue, and a unique drums‑and‑space segment.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this performance – one describes being blown away by the unforgettable drums‑and‑space moment in the hallway, while the other praises the superb soundboard mix and highlights the Shakedown Street jam and the build into Stella Blue. The recording is praised as crystal‑clear, making the show's energy and rare moments shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on both musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and recording quality (excellent soundboard mix), though based on only two reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard mix described as excellent; clear, balanced capture that highlights the band's dynamics.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note a smooth build into Stella Blue and a memorable drums‑and‑space segment, indicating a well‑paced set with strong transitions.

band_member_comments.Drums: Unique chanting sound and memorable drums‑and‑space moment highlighted by a reviewer.
